extras.textures: PBR 2048px: base color, roughness, metallic, normal (baked)
extras.real_size: romantic palace on a rock ridge, approx. 150 m long, tallest tower 84 m above the valley floor (68 m above the rock plateau), on a 222 x 104 m base with fir trees
extras.notes: exterior only (closed buildings, opaque windows, no interior); long axis along X, front faces -Y, gatehouse and access ramp at +X; gold finials instead of crosses; no flags, no text, no emblems; no movable parts

origin.detail: Built procedurally with Blender scripts. The scripts were written with the help of an AI coding assistant. No generative AI model produced the geometry or textures directly.
